prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment backdrop for a side-scrolling 2D beat-em-up web game called NULLPOINT. Create an exceptionally beautiful original hand-painted dark fantasy ruined forest that subtly merges old server hardware with ancient architecture. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, rich cinematic layered parallax feel. Huge twisted black roots and gothic arches at far left and far right, a distant broken circular cathedral window with luminous pale turquoise crystals in the center-right, dark ivy-covered server monoliths, dripping cables, damp stone, soft turquoise mist, firefly motes, a few restrained orange corrupted crystals near ground. Strong black ink contours and detailed painterly textured fills, premium French graphic-novel animation art direction. Color: deep desaturated petrol teal, blue-black, moonlit jade and ivory highlights, tiny amber embers. The bottom 30 percent MUST be a continuous mostly flat broad cobblestone platform traversable horizontally, its walking surface at 76 percent image height, no gaps or obstacles in the center. Environment only, NO characters, NO monsters, NO text, NO UI, no watermark. Clear readable gameplay composition with atmospheric depth and tangible textures. 1536x1024 or larger landscape image.
prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready character sprite atlas with genuine transparent background. Create ONE clean precisely aligned 4 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet, 8 equal cells, landscape 1536x1024. In each cell one full-body animation pose of THE SAME young adult developer turned dark fantasy swordsman. Character faces RIGHT in all cells, three-quarter side view for 2D beat em up. Short dark hair, dark charcoal hooded jacket with oversized teal hood and cloak tails, fingerless gloves, bandage wraps, dark utility trousers, brown boots, amber utility satchel, glowing mint-cyan crystalline code sword held in hand. Original premium hand-painted comic-book animation art, rich nuanced fabric textures, bold ink silhouettes, cyan rimlighting, charismatic lean athletic proportions. All 8 characters exactly same scale, anchored feet near the bottom of each cell. Cell 1 top-left: relaxed combat idle. Cell 2: running stride left foot forward. Cell 3: running stride right foot forward. Cell 4: sword attack anticipation winding arm back. Cell 5 bottom-left: powerful broad sword slash followthrough to right. Cell 6: upward sword slash. Cell 7: low lunging dash with trailing jacket. Cell 8: recoiling from hit. Each sprite isolated with ample transparent padding, no overlaps between cells, absolutely NO panels/grid lines/background/shadows/labels/text, actual transparent alpha background. Keep sword fully within each cell.
prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready enemy sprite atlas for a 2D dark fantasy developer-versus-bugs beat-em-up. ONE precise 3 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet, 6 equal square cells, landscape 1536x1024 with GENUINE TRANSPARENT background. One entire creature per cell, all facing LEFT, consistent orthographic three-quarter side view and hand-painted premium French graphic novel animation style with black ink contours, detailed painterly surfaces. Top row: THREE animation poses of same small BUG CRAWLER monster, low menacing dark chitin beetle with hooked legs, spiky shell with glowing orange error fissures and orange eyes, purple-black body, first idle, second scuttling, third claw attack. Bottom left and bottom middle: TWO poses of a FEATURE CREEP monster, taller hunched horned purple corrupted imp with cyan-magenta rune crystals sprouting out of back, huge oversized claw arms, one idle and one lunging. Bottom right: ONE full-body boss REGRESSION, massive rock golem fused with a haunted server rack, jagged obsidian shoulders, orange hot furnace core, huge stone fists, small burning eyes. All monsters appealing expressive designed silhouettes, detailed fur/chitin/stone textures. Creature fully within own cell with transparent margin, no contact between cells, no panel boundaries, NO text, NO UI, no ground plane or cast shadows, no background. Actual transparency.
